newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia needs better market regulation - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Croatia needs better market regulation - analysts.

text.p: Croatia's securities market needs better central regulation to speed up trade, traders and market participants said on Friday.

"What we need is a central depositary and securities commission. It would help things immensely," said a trader with a large market share during a Zagreb stock exchange conference on the island of Brac.
Croatia, benefitting from a strong presence of foreign investors, is experiencing an unprecedented bull run amid heavy demand for a limited number of shares.
It has a central bourse in Zagreb and another over-the- -counter market in Varazdin and Osijek.
Relatively short supply of shares in a few selected firms and rumoured plans by some firms to float their shares internationally is contributing to a steep price rise, now in its third week.
But traders said settlement was taking too long, very often limiting their buying activities.
"Trading is going strong but what worries us is settlement and share registration," said Darko Ostoja of consultancy and brokerage I.F.C..

Sources close to the market said the appointment of the central market watchdog with two finance ministry officials on it was imminent. But there was no immediate confirmation from the government. --Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
